fit_reason: Whole SUV listed by a private owner in the cars by owner section.
findings: Faded, grayish unpainted black lower bumper cladding on the rear bumper
Faded gray-black front lower bumper and rocker trim
Silver paint looks somewhat flat and dull on the hood and side panels rather than glossy
Light wear and some soiling on the gray carpet and floor mat in the front passenger footwell
Light dust and wear on the gray front seats and door sill area
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 2005 Saturn Vue. It looks well kept, but the black lower bumpers and side trim have faded to gray and the front carpet could use a cleaning. We do pre-sale details that come to you, including trim restoration, a wash and wax, and an interior clean. Would you like a quote?
